# Per-rule corpus. Each line: "<expect> <context> <payload>".
#   expect:  a rule id that must be reported, or "ok" when no rule outside the original XSS set may be reported
#   context: text, url, redirect, id, path, header
#   payload: the rest of the line verbatim; a valid Go-quoted string is unquoted first (for \t \r \n).
# Checked with the strict profile, every rule on, WithRedirectHosts("shop.example.com").
